entries.title: The patient one
entries.notes:
A heron held its place at the water’s edge for almost ten minutes. The whole lake seemed to wait with it.

A reminder to stay a little longer next time.

entries.title: A little gold in the canopy
entries.notes: The alder leaves have started turning. A few were floating in yesterday’s rain, small boats following the same current.

entries.title: Before the world woke up
entries.notes: Low mist over the grass. Wet shoes. The kind of morning that asks for nothing except being there.

entries.title: A voice in the brambles
entries.notes: Heard the wren before I saw it: a small shape with a much bigger song. I sat on the fallen log until it came back.
